$850 billion. Every year. Gone.

Not because of bad strategy. Not because of market conditions.

'Older workers can't keep up with technology.'

Our completion rate with adults 50+: 3X the industry average.
74% feel more confident with technology after training.

The technology gap is not a capability gap.
It is an investment gap.

Your experienced workers are not the problem. The training is.
